profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I focus on building great products with data, technology, and design. I’ve been fortunate to work with some incredible teams to build quality full-stack web applications, and I have a passion for working with CI/CD technologies to make deployment seamless.

For full stack web development I work with React/Redux, Node/Express and either SQL or NoSQL technologies. For DevOps I work with AWS, and am learning Kubernetes when I can.

Before technology, I came from the world of hospitality. I loved traveling and working with diverse teams to deliver quality service to high-end clientele, and the high-paced, high-stress industry gave me a true appreciation of detail-oriented work.

I’m based in Austin, and I’m currently looking for web development and DevOps roles. I love connecting with new people, so feel free to reach out at any time.
